states: Deep link /actions/history selects History and lists recorded outcomes
Deep link /patrol/activity selects Activity; /patrol selects Inbox
Inbox selection keeps ?attention= on the Inbox address
interactions: Actions: History deep link, click Open (path /actions), browser back returns to /actions/history with History selected
Patrol: Activity deep link, click Protection (path /patrol/protection), browser back returns to /patrol/activity
Patrol: select an inbox item, click Activity then Inbox: the ?attention selection and its Browse findings control return
Patrol: Browse Patrol findings for this resource lands on /patrol/activity scrolled to the findings with focus on the findings panel
